title: Exchange Terms of the Crestline Fare Brands: Change Fees, Cutoffs, Residuals and Same-Day Changes
content:
**Tariff schedule — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand, voluntary changes.** This schedule gives, brand by brand, whether a ticket may be exchanged, what a change costs, how late it may be made, what happens to a lower new fare, and the terms of a same-day confirmed change. Amounts are in US dollars per passenger.

## Voluntary exchange

| Fare brand | Voluntary change | Change fee, journey originating in the United States | Change fee, outside-US origin, domestic or short-haul international | Change fee, outside-US origin, long-haul international | Change cutoff before first unflown departure (elapsed hours) | Lower new fare |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | Not permitted | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Forfeited |
| Crestline Main Cabin | Permitted | 0 | 125 | 300 | 1 | Residual credit |
| Crestline Main Plus | Permitted | 0 | 100 | 250 | 1 | Residual credit |
| Crestline Main Flexible | Permitted | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | Refund to original form of payment |
| Crestline Premium Economy | Permitted | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | Residual credit |
| Crestline First | Permitted | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | Refund to original form of payment |

The change fee is per passenger per exchange. "Lower new fare" is the disposition of a negative fare difference on an exchange: a residual credit issues the difference as a Crestline Residual Travel Credit, a refund to the original form of payment pays it back, and forfeited means the difference is kept by Crestline.

## Same-day confirmed change

| Fare brand | Same-day confirmed change sold | Window opens before the original departure (elapsed hours) | Same-day confirmed change fee (per passenger per direction) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | No | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Main Cabin | Yes | 24 | 75 |
| Crestline Main Plus | Yes | 24 | 75 |
| Crestline Main Flexible | Yes | 24 | 0 |
| Crestline Premium Economy | Yes | 24 | 0 |
| Crestline First | Yes | 24 | 0 |

## Notes on the schedule

- Every brand shows a United States-origin change fee of 0. A fee above zero appears only for Crestline Main Cabin (125 and 300) and Crestline Main Plus (100 and 250), and only on journeys originating outside the United States.
- Crestline Basic Economy sells neither a voluntary change nor a same-day confirmed change; its figures of 0 in those columns reflect that no such product is sold.
- The same-day confirmed change fee is 75 dollars on Crestline Main Cabin and Crestline Main Plus and 0 on the other brands that sell the change.
